communityBank.source: Illustrative sector medians (Q1 2026 Call Report / industry summaries)

creditUnion.source: Illustrative sector medians (Q1 2026 NCUA / industry summaries)

metrics.name: Return on assets (ROA / ROAA)
metrics.formula: ROA = Net Income / Average Total Assets
metrics.dataSource: GL / Call Report (banks) or 5300 Call Report (CUs)
metrics.bankNotes: Primary earnings KPI for shareholder-owned banks. Pair with ROE.
metrics.cuNotes: Expect structurally lower ROA than banks — value returned via rates/fees/service. Still the capital-build constraint.

metrics.name: Return on equity (ROE)
metrics.formula: ROE = Net Income / Average Equity Capital
metrics.bankNotes: Shareholder return lens. Less meaningful for CUs (no stock equity).
metrics.cuNotes: Not standard for credit unions; use ROA and net worth growth instead.

metrics.name: EPS growth
metrics.formula: EPS Growth = (EPS_t - EPS_t-1) / |EPS_t-1|
metrics.bankNotes: Relevant for stock banks and holding companies. Skip for mutuals.
metrics.cuNotes: N/A — credit unions do not issue stock.

metrics.name: Net interest margin (NIM)
metrics.formula: NIM = (Interest Income - Interest Expense) / Average Earning Assets
metrics.bankNotes: Core community bank revenue engine. Annualize YTD consistently.
metrics.cuNotes: Same formula. CU tax exemption and member pricing often compress ROA even when NIM is competitive.

metrics.name: Efficiency ratio
metrics.formula: Efficiency = Noninterest Expense / (NII + Noninterest Income)
metrics.bankNotes: Lower is better. Document one-time exclusions (core conversion, M&A).
metrics.cuNotes: Structurally higher than banks (member service model). Compare to CU peers, not bank peers.

metrics.name: Noninterest income / total revenue
metrics.formula: NII Mix = Noninterest Income / (NII + Noninterest Income)
metrics.bankNotes: Diversification from spread income (treasury, wealth, card, fees).
metrics.cuNotes: Often lower by design — CUs return value via lower fees rather than fee maximization.

metrics.name: Loan growth
metrics.formula: Loan Growth = (Ending Gross Loans - Beginning Gross Loans) / Beginning Gross Loans
metrics.bankNotes: Segment C&I, CRE, consumer, ag in drill-down.
metrics.cuNotes: Segment auto, mortgage, credit card, MBL. Watch MBL statutory cap.

metrics.name: Deposit / share growth
metrics.formula: Growth = (Ending Balances - Beginning Balances) / Beginning Balances
metrics.bankNotes: Banks: deposits. Prefer core deposit growth for franchise quality.
metrics.cuNotes: Credit unions: shares. Same growth math; nomenclature differs.

metrics.name: Tier 1 leverage / CET1 (capital adequacy)
metrics.formula: Tier 1 Leverage = Tier 1 Capital / Average Total Assets (per Call Report)
metrics.bankNotes: CBLR option may apply for qualifying community banks (~9% leverage).
metrics.cuNotes: Use Net Worth Ratio instead.

metrics.name: Net worth ratio
metrics.formula: Net Worth Ratio = Net Worth / Total Assets
inputs: Net worth (retained earnings + other NCUA components)
metrics.bankNotes: Bank analog is Tier 1 / equity ratios.
metrics.cuNotes: Only capital build path is retained earnings. Well capitalized typically ≥ 7%.

metrics.name: Net worth / capital growth
metrics.formula: Capital Growth = (Ending Capital - Beginning Capital) / Beginning Capital
metrics.bankNotes: Includes retained earnings and capital actions (stock, dividends).
metrics.cuNotes: Critical for CUs — cannot issue stock. ROA × retention ≈ capital growth engine.
metrics.typicalBankTarget: Retain enough to fund growth + dividends
metrics.typicalCuTarget: Retain enough to fund asset growth and stay well capitalized

metrics.name: Member benefit / patronage capacity
metrics.formula: Member Benefit ≈ Rate/fee advantage vs market + patronage dividends (board method)
metrics.bankNotes: Bank analog is shareholder dividend + franchise value — different stakeholder.
metrics.cuNotes: Cooperatives measure value returned to members, not just ROA maximization.
metrics.typicalCuTarget: Board-defined $ or bps returned per member

metrics.name: Core deposit / share mix
metrics.formula: Core Mix = Core Funding / Total Deposits or Shares
metrics.bankNotes: Exclude CDs, brokered, listing-service for 'core'.
metrics.cuNotes: Core shares = share draft + regular shares + money market; exclude certificates if policy says so.

metrics.name: Core deposit / share growth
metrics.formula: Core Growth = (Ending Core - Beginning Core) / Beginning Core
metrics.bankNotes: Franchise funding quality metric.
metrics.cuNotes: Same concept with share nomenclature.

metrics.name: Products per household
metrics.formula: Products per Household = Active Product Relationships / Households
metrics.bankNotes: Bank standard relationship-depth KPI. Householding quality is critical.
metrics.cuNotes: CU analog is Average Member Relationship / products per member.

metrics.name: Average member relationship
metrics.formula:
AMR = (Total Loans + Total Shares) / Number of Members
Companion: Products per Member = Active Products / Members
metrics.bankNotes: Bank analog is products per household / deposit+loan per HH.
metrics.cuNotes: Signature CU franchise metric. Track loans/member and shares/member separately.

metrics.name: Customer / member growth
metrics.formula:
Growth = (Ending Count - Beginning Count) / Beginning Count
Also: Net New = New - Closed
metrics.bankNotes: Often households, not warm bodies. Define active vs total.
metrics.cuNotes: Members are the ownership base. Net new members per branch is a common ops cut.

metrics.name: Satisfaction / NPS
metrics.formula: NPS = % Promoters - % Detractors (or CSAT mean per survey vendor)
metrics.bankNotes: Customer satisfaction / NPS.
metrics.cuNotes: Member satisfaction / NPS; often tied to cooperative identity.

metrics.name: Digital active rate
metrics.formula: Digital Active = Digital Active Users / Eligible Base
metrics.bankNotes: Lock enrolled vs all-customer denominator.
metrics.cuNotes: Same metric; often paired with bill-pay / home-banking penetration.

metrics.name: Customer / member retention
metrics.formula: Retention = 1 - (Closed Relationships / Beginning Relationships)
metrics.bankNotes: Household retention preferred over account-level churn.
metrics.cuNotes: Member retention; watch dormant purge policy effects.

metrics.name: Cross-sell / referral conversion
metrics.formula:
Cross-Sell Rate = Additional Products Sold / Eligible Interactions
Or Referrals Closed / Referrals Made
metrics.bankNotes: Drives products/HH and fee income.
metrics.cuNotes: Drives products/member and AMR.

metrics.name: Deposit / share market share
metrics.formula: Market Share = Institution Deposits or Shares / Market Total (defined geography)
inputs: FDIC Summary of Deposits or CU market data
metrics.bankNotes: Branch county/MSA share common for community banks.
metrics.cuNotes: Harder for SEGs; geography or employer SEG share as available.

metrics.name: Loan decision cycle time
metrics.formula: Median(Decision Timestamp - Application Received Timestamp)
metrics.bankNotes: Split consumer auto vs commercial manual.
metrics.cuNotes: Split auto/mortgage/MBL queues.

metrics.name: Loan originations per lending FTE
metrics.formula: Originations per FTE = Funded Loans in Period / Lending FTEs
metrics.bankNotes: Productivity cut for lending ops.
metrics.cuNotes: Same; useful branch and central underwriting views.

metrics.name: Loan-to-deposit / loan-to-share
metrics.formula:
Banks: LTD = Total Loans / Total Deposits
CUs: LTS = Total Loans / Total Shares
metrics.bankNotes: Balance sheet utilization. Too high = liquidity stress; too low = under-earning.
metrics.cuNotes: Same concept with shares. Often ALCO primary liquidity utilization KPI.

metrics.name: STP / exception rate
metrics.formula:
STP Rate = Straight-Through Items / Total Items
Exception Rate = Exceptions / Total Items
metrics.bankNotes: Ops efficiency leading indicator for efficiency ratio.
metrics.cuNotes: Same.

metrics.name: Member onboarding cycle time
metrics.formula: Median(Account Ready Timestamp - Membership Application Timestamp)
metrics.bankNotes: Bank analog: new account opening cycle time.
metrics.cuNotes: Includes FOM eligibility checks unique to CU model.
metrics.typicalCuTarget: Same-day to ≤ 2 days digital; branch SLA

metrics.name: Field-of-membership adherence
metrics.formula:
FOM Pass Rate = Memberships Confirmed Eligible / New Memberships
Also track exceptions / audit findings
metrics.bankNotes: N/A for banks (no FOM).
metrics.cuNotes: Regulatory identity control unique to credit unions.

metrics.name: Commercial / C&I pipeline conversion
metrics.formula: Conversion = Funded Commercial / Qualified Pipeline Opportunities
metrics.bankNotes: Community banks often differentiate on commercial relationship banking.
metrics.cuNotes: Limited by MBL caps; track MBL pipeline separately if material.

metrics.name: Member business lending utilization vs cap
metrics.formula: MBL Utilization = MBL Outstanding / Statutory Cap (~12.25% of assets, subject to exceptions)
metrics.bankNotes: Banks have no equivalent statutory MBL cap.
metrics.cuNotes: Hard regulatory constraint shaping CU commercial strategy.

metrics.name: Employee engagement / satisfaction
metrics.formula: Survey mean or engagement index per vendor method
metrics.bankNotes: Leading indicator for service and sales execution.
metrics.cuNotes: Same; cooperative culture often emphasized.

metrics.name: Voluntary turnover
metrics.formula: Voluntary Turnover = Voluntary Separations / Average Headcount
metrics.bankNotes: Segment tellers vs lenders vs specialists.
metrics.cuNotes: Same.

metrics.name: Training hours per FTE
metrics.formula: Training Hours per FTE = Total Training Hours / Average FTE
metrics.bankNotes: Emphasize commercial credit, BSA, cyber.
metrics.cuNotes: Emphasize member service, BSA, lending, board education hours separately.

metrics.name: Commercial lending skill coverage
metrics.formula: Certified / Credentialed Commercial Lenders / Commercial Lender Seats
metrics.bankNotes: Supports C&I/CRE franchise depth.
metrics.cuNotes: Optional for CUs with MBL programs.

metrics.name: Volunteer board education hours
metrics.formula: Average Education Hours per Director per Year
metrics.bankNotes: Bank boards may track director education; less distinctive.
metrics.cuNotes: Volunteer lay boards are a CU governance hallmark.

metrics.name: Member financial education reach
metrics.formula: Members Reached by Education Programs / Total Members (or absolute completions)
metrics.bankNotes: Banks may run community education; less core to ownership model.
metrics.cuNotes: Supports cooperative mission and member value proposition.

metrics.name: Criticized / classified assets
metrics.formula: Criticized = (SM + Substandard + Doubtful + Loss) / Gross Loans
metrics.bankNotes: Do not confuse criticized (incl. SM) with classified-only.
metrics.cuNotes: Same credit language; delinquency often primary for consumer-heavy books.

metrics.name: Past due 30+ / delinquency
metrics.formula: Past Due 30+ = UPB ≥ 30 DPD / Gross Loans
metrics.bankNotes: Show buckets 30-59 / 60-89 / 90+.
metrics.cuNotes: Primary asset-quality KPI for many CUs.

metrics.name: Net charge-offs
metrics.formula: NCO Ratio = (Charge-offs - Recoveries) / Average Loans
metrics.bankNotes: Annualize consistently with peer reports.
metrics.cuNotes: Same.

metrics.name: ACL / allowance coverage
metrics.formula: Coverage = ACL / Nonperforming Loans (or Criticized) — pick board definition
metrics.bankNotes: CECL-driven; document coverage definition.
metrics.cuNotes: Same under CECL for most CUs.

metrics.name: CRE concentration
metrics.formula: CRE / Total Risk-Based Capital (per interagency guidance definitions)
metrics.bankNotes: Classic community bank concentration risk KPI.
metrics.cuNotes: Less central unless MBL/CRE book grows; track MBL concentration instead.

metrics.name: Wholesale funding reliance
metrics.formula: Wholesale = (Brokered + Listing + FHLB + Other Wholesale) / Total Liabilities
metrics.bankNotes: Pair with on-hand liquidity (cash + unpledged securities + unused FHLB).
metrics.cuNotes: Same concept; share insurance and corporate CU lines may differ.

metrics.name: On-hand liquidity / coverage days
metrics.formula:
On-Hand Liquidity = Cash + Unpledged Securities + Unused Secured Borrowing / Total Assets
Or Coverage Days vs stressed outflows
metrics.bankNotes: Community bank ALCO staple.
metrics.cuNotes: Same ALCO staple.

metrics.name: Interest rate risk sensitivity
metrics.formula: NII or EVE change under ±100/±200/±300 bp shocks (ALM model)
metrics.bankNotes: Sensitivity-to-market-risk CAMELS component.
metrics.cuNotes: Same; consumer fixed-rate books can heighten EVE risk.

metrics.name: BSA / AML alert aging
metrics.formula: Avg Alert Age = Sum(Age Days) / Open Alerts; Aged Share = Alerts >30d / Open
metrics.bankNotes: Always show aged tail %, not only average.
metrics.cuNotes: Same examiner focus.

metrics.name: Cyber / IT key risk indicators
metrics.formula: Board pack typically: patch SLA breaches, MFA coverage gaps, critical incidents, phishing fail rate
metrics.bankNotes: FFIEC IT Handbook aligned.
metrics.cuNotes: Same; NCUA examiner focus rising with digital.

metrics.name: Exam / DOR finding aging
metrics.formula: Open Matters Requiring Attention (or DOR) by age band
metrics.bankNotes: Management component leading indicator.
metrics.cuNotes: Same.
